scripts.dev: concurrently --prefix "[{name}]" --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && uv sync --directory backend
scripts.desktop: npm run build --prefix frontend && uv run --directory backend --group desktop python ../desktop/launcher.py
